description: Zero-result response for an UNPINNED record_search (no collectionId) for 'Unna' with the ABBREVIATED surname 'Halsteinsdr'. In given-name-variant-secondary-party the pinned 'Unna Halsteinsdr' search in collection 1468080 returns zero (record-search-unna-exact-zero-results), so research_log_append refuses to log it until the same names are searched without the collection (research-log-editor-spec.md section 8.5). Without this fixture that retry hit fixture_not_found in run v12_2026-11-04_04-07-06. It returns zero because the real index entry is 'Urna', not 'Unna', so the test still has to reach the given-name variant. Used only by given-name-variant-secondary-party: in combined-given-surname-variant-secondary-party a pinned 'Halsteinsdr' search already finds the record, so this retry is never demanded there and a zero answer would contradict the pinned hit. The predicate cannot require collectionId to be absent; it only ever sees unpinned calls because it is listed LAST, after the collection-1468080 fixtures that answer every pinned call first.
